Let us find strength in each other's support and remain resolute in our determination to overcome these dark times. As one, we will face the challenges ahead with bravery and hope.

Together, we will not waver. We will not back down. We will keep fighting back until our town is free from the shadow of treachery.

In these darkest of hours, we must remember that we are a community bonded by shared values and history. Let us hold each other close and stand as a beacon of hope, guiding our way to a brighter future.

With hearts full of solidarity and a commitment to our cause, we press forward, knowing that the light of justice and unity will shine upon us once more.

Farmer's Father is not a sequel, prequel or a "cash grab" it's a spin-off of Farmer's Life

2. Baby
A baby in Farmer's Father is not Casimir from Farmer's Life.

Farmer's Father is mainly a story-based adventure and survival with some simulation mechanics indie game.

4. Similarities to Farmer's Life
* Same engine
* Some assets are used from Farmer's Life
* Many mechanics are very similar to Farmer's Life

5. Differences
* Made by different team, new other than Farmer's Life
* More directed play
* Story-based
* More linearity than Farmer's life
* New mechanics

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

Welcome to our first devlog!
 
[previewyoutube=XEnS6cYkTqg;full][/previewyoutube]

First off: the story

We changed a story for Farmer’s Father, since it’s a prequel of the Farmer's Life game. We want to make it clear that our main hero is Kasimir’s Father, along with Kasimir’s mother and Kasimir brother.

Gameplay:

 we added a dog that will help us during our journey, he will search for useful things such as chests hidden by partisans and warn us against any danger.
now you can loot abandoned houses by opening drawers in cabinets. You can also find precious items that will help you survive.
your safe place is a dugout, we are working on customization of this place. You will be able to make it your second home.
the most important thing in Farmer’s Father is that you can’t fight with enemy soldiers, you should avoid them. The safest way to travel is doing it during a night, soldiers will only see you if you reach a lit area. 

Changes:

we are working on UI, we want to reach one style for this game so it’s a work in progress.
we changed a light in the game, to make it more enjoyable for your eyes, also we make sure that night is darker than before. 
and of course now you will be able to drink water from the lake and any other river in the world.

Plans for the future:
Our main goal is optimization and adding more mechanics to the game. You have to survive 365 days, so we need to make sure you won’t be bored. If you have any ideas what we can add then reach us on our Discord. 

See you next time.
Farmer's Father team
